# The Middleman

> A Nigerian-first marketplace for ready-made digital products from independent creators. Buyers can review listing details and previews, then pay in Naira through Paystack.

- [Home](https://themiddleman.com.ng/): Overview of the marketplace.
- [Marketplace](https://themiddleman.com.ng/marketplace): Browse public digital product listings.
- [About](https://themiddleman.com.ng/about): Information about The Middleman.
- [Terms of Service](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/terms): Platform terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/privacy): How personal data is handled.
- [Cookie Policy](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/cookies): Information about cookies and browser storage.
- [Refund and Dispute Policy](https://themiddleman.com.ng/legal/refunds): Published refund information.
- [Sitemap](https://themiddleman.com.ng/sitemap.xml): Public page and active product URLs.

This file is a discovery aid. It does not describe private accounts or orders, and it is not a product ranking signal.
